description: Awarding the contract for the construction of a ten-storied building for the Faculty of Commerce and Management Studies of the University of Kelaniya
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-02-03 to call for bids by following the national competitive bidding method and select a contractor to implement the project for the construction of a ten‑storied building for the Faculty of Commerce and Management Studies of the University of Kelaniya, which had been halted due to the economic crisis. Accordingly, bids were invited, and ten (10) bids were received. Taking into consideration the recommendations submitted by the High Level Procurement Committee and the Procurement Appeal Board following the evaluation of those bids, the proposal made by the Hon. Prime Minister in her capacity as the Minister of Education, Higher Education, and Vocational Education to award the said contract to M/s Sathuta Builders (Pvt) Ltd., substantially responsive lowest evaluated bidder, for a sum of Rs.1.73 billion (excluding Value Added Tax), was approved by the Cabinet.
